name: Humbaba
bible: A HULKING, HUNCHED beast-giant: heavy-boned, shoulders far wider than his head, a low forward-leaning stance. Head: a LION-LIKE skull with a tawny muzzle of short fur, a heavy dark brow, two glowing RED eyes, a snarl of long ivory FANGS with embers and wisps of FIRE at the jaws, and two curved dark BULL HORNS sweeping forward from the crown. A thick shaggy black MANE like twisted cedar roots, bound with BRONZE rings, falls over the shoulders and back. Body: dark IRON-GREY scaled hide, plates of dark BRONZE armour on chest and shoulders engraved with plain wedge patterns, a dark leather war-belt, bronze-banded forearm cuffs, and NO cloth, cape or drape of any kind: bare scaled hide below the belt. A long scaled SERPENT tail ends in a hissing snake head and is kept coiled low behind his legs. WEAPON: NONE. His hands hold no weapon. Both hands are huge LION PAWS, each as big as his own head, with long curved BLACK-IRON TALONS; fangs and beast strength are his other arsenal. Energy and effects: CRIMSON claw-mark arcs (four parallel lines), red-orange embers and fire from the jaws, seven crimson rings in his Terror art. Palette: iron grey, bronze, crimson.
design:
- top row, left half: full-body hunched stance facing right with both clawed paws raised
- top row, right half: a head close-up of the lion skull, bull horns, fangs and fire at the jaw; a close view of one clawed paw with black-iron talons
- second row, left half: a two-handed overhead claw smash and a wide raking swipe, crimson rake lines
- second row, right half: a prowling walk on all fours and a pouncing leap
- third row, left half: both paws slammed into the cracked ground, and a mid-air rake
- third row, right half: a plunge pounce claws first and a rising uppercut rake
- bottom row, left half: a guard with the forearms crossed in front of the face, and a hit reaction
- bottom row, right half: a victory roar with both arms raised, and the Seven Terrors with seven crimson rings blazing around him

sheetNotes.idle: The hunched stance is held in every frame: the claws stay forward and low, or the forearms are crossed in the guard, and the talons stay spread. The mane and the wisps of fire at the jaws drift and flicker with each breath; the horns and the crimson eyes stay steady. The serpent tail stays coiled close behind the legs. No weapon is held in any frame.
sheetNotes.run: Heavy, loping strides, very low; sometimes he knuckles forward on one paw. Both clawed paws are the only limbs in front, and no weapon is held in any frame. The mane bounces with each stride. Keep the serpent tail coiled close behind his legs in EVERY frame, never reaching past his own cell (neighbouring frames must not touch).
sheetNotes.air: Airborne with the claws spread wide and the mane streaming; the serpent tail trails close behind him, never past his own cell. No weapon in the hands. In the wall slide and ledge frames the claws grip the wall or the ledge.
sheetNotes.dash: A heavy low roll and a low ground pounce: the claws are tucked in during the roll and rake the ground on the ground dash. The healing flask is pinched in one clawed paw, never held in a weapon grip. The serpent tail stays coiled close, never past his own cell. No weapon in any frame.
sheetNotes.hurt: Hit reactions with the hands empty: nothing is dropped, the claws are spread or pulled in. The mane whips with each blow, the head snapped back and the eyes squeezed shut in pain. The serpent tail stays coiled close behind the legs.
sheetNotes.atk-a: Two heavy claw combos. Combo 1 is a two-handed overhead claw smash with the paws and talons, combo 2 is a wide raking swipe. Crimson claw-mark rake lines (four parallel lines) are opaque, hard-edged bands kept inside the cell. No weapon in the hands; the talons are the weapon.
sheetNotes.atk-b: Combo finisher: both paws slammed into the ground, the cracked earth and the crimson shockwave are the strongest pose, painted as hard-edged stepped bands kept inside the cell. Aerial attack: a pouncing mid-air rake with four crimson claw arcs. No weapon; the paws, talons and fangs are the attacks.
sheetNotes.atk-c: Plunge: a claw-first dive, both paws hitting the ground with a crater burst of dust and embers. Heavy attack: a rising uppercut rake from low to high with a tall crimson claw arc kept inside the cell. No weapon in the hands at any point.
sheetNotes.art: Seven Terrors, his rage art, painted as opaque hard-edged crimson rings and bands kept inside the cell. 1: he roars, a first crimson ring flares around his body. 2: more rings ignite one after another until SEVEN concentric crimson rings surround him, eyes blazing. 3: he slams both paws down and a crimson shockwave bursts outward, kept inside the cell. 4: full frenzy, all seven rings blazing around him, embers swirling. 5: the rings dim to a faint red sheen. 6: he stands tall, chest heaving, a faint glow on the talons. No weapon in the hands.
sheetNotes.skill: Terror Roar, his own special: a roar that freezes the enemy in fear. Both paws stay on the ground and no weapon is held. 1: he plants both paws and rears his head back, chest swelling. 2: jaws wide open, fire glowing in the throat. 3: he roars forward, a red shock of sound leaving the mouth. 4: the roar at full force, crimson concentric fear-waves rolling outward as opaque hard-edged bands, kept inside the cell. 5: the waves thin out, embers drift. 6: back to stance, both clawed arms raised.
sheetNotes.misc: Skill throw: he tears a chunk of rock and cedar root from the ground with both paws and hurls it with one arm; this is the only time an object leaves his hands. Taunt: he pounds his chest with both paws and roars, then rakes the ground with his talons. Victory: he rears up to full height roaring, both clawed arms raised, faint crimson rings flickering around him. No weapon is held at any point.
sheetNotes.ko: Defeat: he staggers, drops to the knees, collapses forward and lies still, his claws slipping from the ground. Intro: he prowls in low on all fours, rears up to his full height roaring with fire at the jaws, slams both paws onto the ground, and settles into the hunched stance. No weapon is held at any point.
